patch.summary: Is Bombora worth it? B2B intent-data specialist best known for Company Surge® topic-level buying signals that help sales and marketing teams prioritize in-market accounts — typically layered onto CRM/ABM stacks rather than used as a contact database.. Strong when ABM and enterprise sales teams that need third-party intent layered onto CRM/ABM stacks. Weak when Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database.

blocks.body: Bombora earns a yes only when researched fit beats researched limits — not when the brand is familiar.

sections.heading: Bombora ROI gate for evaluators
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Worth the seat spend if contact data + prospecting are weekly must-haves. Counter-signal: Not worth it if Intent-data specialist — not a B2B email/phone contact database collide with your constraints.

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Marketo.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Company Surge, Intent Data Platform.

sections.heading: Who Bombora is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Bombora when third-party intent data is a named buying criterion and you already have (or will buy) contact data and engagement tools separately..

Avoid if: Compare 6sense or Demandbase when you want intent bundled inside a full ABM platform, and ZoomInfo when you need enterprise contact data with intent add-ons..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with 6sense on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Bombora price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
